Nice discussions, folks.

I so dearly hold the same view as Aswilled --- although with a bit doubt that price has not cleared the higher supply zone Art marked. Because of that, I feel buying at each demand below a little shaky

So many places and trainings say trade strictly by the rules, that has its own merit, but as time goes on, I come to realize that a trader's feeling or sync with the market traded can become just the thing that makes one profitable or more profitable. Recent examples include Art's early exit on USDJPY and Aswilled's not so clear entry into the EURUSD trade discussed. What do you guys say about this? do you feel the same?

Sean.
